content.short: Jump Crypto is a crypto venture capital firm investing in and developing infrastructure across blockchains, including Solana.
content.description: Jump Crypto helps build software infrastructure and tools for blockchain ecosystems while engaging in trading and market-making activities that contribute to more efficient global crypto markets. For more than six years, its team has contributed to decentralized, open-source tooling for public blockchains and has acted as founding code contributors to notable projects such as the Pyth network, an oracle for real-time on-chain market data, and Wormhole, a cross-chain interoperability protocol.
